company.name: Sureform
company.shortDescription: Sureform provides a multimodal human data platform that supplies real-world audio and video datasets for AI and robotics training.
company.description: Sureform provides a multimodal human data platform focused on collecting real-world human audio and video to train advanced AI and robotics systems. The company operates a contributor network that records speech, sound, and first-person video of everyday physical tasks in environments such as restaurants, warehouses, and hotels. These recordings capture interactions, object handling, and navigation in real-world settings. Sureform standardizes and processes this multimodal data into structured datasets suitable for training robotics labs, world models, and robot foundation models. Its services are aimed at AI research teams, robotics companies, and organizations building multimodal and embodied AI systems. By licensing curated human interaction datasets, Sureform supports the development of models that can better perceive and act in physical environments.

productsAndServices.description: A contributor network and platform that collects and licenses real-world audio and first-person video datasets for AI and robotics training.
